# Learned instinct: change-rollback-plan-required (confidence 0.95)

Every proposed change to production infrastructure must include a rollback plan. For Ansible: a rollback playbook or documented manual steps. For package changes: the previous artifact version to redeploy. For config changes: the previous config value and the command to restore it. Rollback plans are reviewed by the playbook-reviewer agent and must be included in the MR description.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 6.5.4 — back-out procedures
